# Codex CLI integration

Codex CLI reads instructions from `AGENTS.md` and has no scoped-rule or hook mechanism (verified 2026-07-24).
Wards gives it the scrolls' content through a managed pointer block; hooks are skipped for Codex.

## Rules and templates

Add a clearly-marked, wards-managed block to `AGENTS.md`:

- **project** scope: the repo-root `AGENTS.md`.
- **user** scope: `~/.codex/AGENTS.md`.

Delimit the block so the updater can find and regenerate it, and so a reader knows it is generated:

```markdown
<!-- wards-managed:start — generated from .agents/, regenerated by /wards; edit the canonical files -->

## Project rules (wards)

- Before editing TypeScript files, read `.agents/rules/typescript-code-style.md`.
- Before editing any file, read `.agents/rules/general-code-style.md`.

<!-- wards-managed:end -->
```

Each pointer line names the scroll's applicability condition in prose (from `ward.applicability`) and points at the canonical `.agents/` path, so Codex loads the same content Claude Code scopes natively.
A scroll with no `applicability` gets an unconditional pointer ("Always read `<path>`").

Write the pointer path at the scope the block lives at.
A project-scope block points at the repo-relative `.agents/rules/<name>.md`; a user-scope block in `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` is read from inside whatever repository the session opened, where a repo-relative path names a file that does not exist, so it points at the absolute `~/.agents/rules/<name>.md` instead.

Only this block is wards-owned; the rest of `AGENTS.md` (including any template ancestry) is the user's.

## Recording provenance in AGENTS.md

An `AGENTS.md` that descends from a template scroll records that ancestry in the file itself: `wards status` scans `AGENTS.md` and `.codex/AGENTS.md` for exactly this, and a template recorded nowhere else is a template nothing can ever check.

Write the ward block as YAML frontmatter at the very top of the file, before the first heading:

```markdown
---
ward:
  kind: template
  description: The project's AGENTS.md, descended from a template scroll.
  version: 1.0.0
  provenance:
    - source: owner/repo
      path: templates/agents-md-template.md
      version: 1.0.0
      notes: kept the project's own release section, dropped the sample commands
---

# AGENTS.md
```

The `version` is the template's, carried forward on each update; the `notes` are where the project's divergence from the template is explained, since a template file diverges by design.
When the file already carries a ward block, extend its `provenance` list rather than replacing it: one `AGENTS.md` can descend from a template and aggregate other upstreams at once.

## Hooks

Skipped: Codex has no hook mechanism.
A hook scroll installs its canonical file under `.agents/hooks/` regardless, so another harness can still wire it.
